name: Zai Wuxian Chongsheng Zhong Shouhu Ni
source:
“No matter how many times I have to do it, I will save you!”

I was apprehensive about marrying Erisa, but I never hesitated or wavered. I was sure that she was the one I wanted to be with for the rest of my life.

And yet, in the midst of the endless nightmare, my tender, sweet fiancée was left exposed to the abuse of other people—and things that could not be named.
I cried out from my heart, but it did not reach her ears. I could only watch her sink into the sea of desire, her inner self emptied by sexual pleasure and her body a vessel for an unknown existence.

“Who are you—I know you are not her!”

What kind of secrets lay on this island?
Was it divine mercy, or the devil's mischief?

No matter how many times I had to restart and repeat, I would take Erisa away from this script where her death was a fixed point…

Get away, get away, get away, get away, get away, get away, get away, get away, get away—
No matter how difficult, I would rescue Erisa!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1778280/Rescuing_You_in_the_Infinite_Loop/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“无论多少次，我都会救你！”

我对嫁给艾丽莎感到担心，但我从未犹豫或动摇。我确信她就是我想与之共度余生的人。

然而，在无尽的噩梦中，我温柔甜蜜的未婚妻却遭受了其他人的虐待——以及一些无法命名的事情。
我心里呐喊，却没有传到她的耳朵里。我只能看着她沉入欲望的海洋，她的内心被性快感掏空，她的身体成为未知存在的容器。

“你是谁——我知道你不是她！”

这座岛上到底隐藏着什么样的秘密？
是神的怜悯，还是魔鬼的恶作剧？

无论我必须重新开始和重复多少次，我都会把艾丽莎从这个她的死亡作为固定点的剧本中带走……

快走，快走，快走，快走，快走，快走，快走，快走，快走——
无论多么困难，我都会救出艾丽莎！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1778280/Rescuing_You_in_the_Infinite_Loop/]Steam[/url]]
